{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes, showing a persistent lag that widens as the horizon extends",
    "Sentiment positively correlates with price movements but model forecasts underweight sentiment momentum, especially at longer horizons",
    "Price mean-reversion is present in the data but model forecasts overshoot the mean too aggressively, creating systematic undervaluation",
    "When sentiment is strongly positive (>=0.67), model forecasts need an additional 0.5-1.0% lift to match true outcomes",
    "The forecast bias increases by approximately 0.02-0.03% per day into the future, suggesting linear lag accumulation",
    "When current price is near the 18-day low, model forecasts are too conservative and need upward adjustment relative to sentiment signals",
    "Sentiment turning from negative to positive requires a quicker model response than the baseline lag captures" ]
}
